reason: The candidate action calls modify_pending_order_items with 3 item_ids but an empty new_item_ids array. The policy's 'Modify items' action only permits changing an item to a different option of the same product type ('each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option'), with new_item_ids matching item_ids position-for-position. There is no policy-supported action for removing specific items from a pending order while keeping other items — 'cancel pending order' only cancels the entire order, and 'modify items' requires a same-type replacement, not removal. The conversation's plan (cancel just the office items, keep the hiking boots and helmet) has no valid tool mapping; using modify_pending_order_items with empty new_item_ids is not an authorized use of that tool and does not correspond to any policy-defined action.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
Each new item id should match the item id in the same position and be of the same product.
An order can only be cancelled if its status is 'pending'... After user confirmation, the order status will be changed to 'cancelled'
